name: Daily Bounty: Highway Rats
description: Giant rats from the city sewers have taken to raiding the Merchant's Highway waystations. The waystation keepers will pay to see them culled.

start_condition.start_hint: Ask the vault keeper in any town — bounties are posted there day and night.

stages.description: Cull the giant rats raiding the Merchant's Highway.

encounter.text: A squealing pair of giant rats bursts from a ditch beside the road, bold as anything.

stages.description: Return to any vault keeper to claim your bounty.

objectives.description: Claim your bounty from any vault keeper.
